name: 丘陵半身人·男·小个子
src: 主角预设（11-10）：半身人·丘陵半身人，男，小个子
who: A young halfling man from the Meadhill orchards and windmill fields, about twenty-two, a guild adventurer just starting out: about 100 cm tall, a small round frame, with the round, soft, youthful face of his people. Short curly peach-blonde hair, bright spring-green eyes, a dusting of freckles across his nose and round cheeks. Fair skin with a faint warm flush. A cheerful, easy-going air, a young man who makes sure everyone is fed.
build: About 100 cm, a small round frame.
palette: cream, apple red, wheat gold, bark brown, one small spring-green accent
casual: His everyday kit: a cream linen shirt buttoned to the throat with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a fitted apple-red leather vest with brass buttons, a long brown apron over the front, short trousers with braces tucked into sturdy boots, a small cloth satchel of herbs across the body, a small bronze guild token at the belt. Both hands holding the satchel strap, a wide, warm grin.
private: At home in the evening: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, braces, comfortable trousers, thick woollen socks, a floury cloth over one shoulder. He holds a plate of small buns in both hands. A sleepy, contented smile.
battle: A guild-issued starting kit: a padded wheat-gold gambeson buttoned to the throat under a short leather jerkin with light steel plates on the shoulders, thick leather bracers, a small round wooden shield on his left forearm, sturdy boots, a satchel of herbs and bread at the belt. In his right hand a short sword with a plain guard, held upright. A firm, cheerful stance.
formal: A neat formal dress for a village feast: a fitted deep red tailored coat to the knee with a high collar, cream piping and a row of small brass buttons, a clean white shirt, dark short trousers, polished shoes, the curls combed down. Standing very straight, a little proud and a little stiff.
art: A wide grin at the viewer, a small round loaf held up in one hand, warm golden orchard light behind him, apples blurred in the foreground.
battle_note: Keep the small round proportions in every outfit; the shield sits on his left forearm (on the viewer's right when they face us).

art: Holding a steaming pie up beside her cheek, looking straight at the viewer with a wide dimpled smile, warm golden light, a wooden spoon tucked into the bun pin.
